scope.flow: previewWithdraw(max assets) after a realistic deposit into the floor-sqrt share vault
scope.environment: Solidity vault using PRBMath and floor square root share conversion

statements.text: A realistic deposit has occurred, with minDeposit = 1e16 so virtually every real deposit produces non-round shares.
After the deposit, totalAssets is strictly greater than HALF_SLOPE * totalShares^2 by 1-2 wei.
A caller calls previewWithdraw(totalAssets, totalAssets, totalShares).
_convertToShares computes shares by taking a floor square root, so the sqrt operation floors the result and the vault retains slightly more assets than the curve requires.
The withdraw path, including previewWithdraw for max-asset withdrawals, should remain operational after a realistic deposit rather than reverting.
previewWithdraw should not underflow in its internal PRBMath subtraction when totalAssets exceeds HALF_SLOPE * totalShares^2 by 1-2 wei.
previewWithdraw is assumed to be used as a helper by functions inheriting totalAssets.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether the caller is authorized or permissionless; 'anyone' appears only in the previewWithdraw call description.
The 1-2 wei gap is described as a post-deposit state, so it is treated as a precondition only because the report frames it as existing before the previewWithdraw call.
Exact HALF_SLOPE constant and curve equation are not numerically specified.
Whether redeem(totalShares) working is a separate intent or just context is unclear.
